title: George and the Storm on the Hill

learning.summary_zh: 短途採莓時暴風雨與熊出現；學會冷靜、安靜、躲藏，並回洞穴避雨；Daddy 上山接人。
focus_en: Safety: Stay quiet. Don't run. Stay calm. hide / shelter
Wild animals: bear, growl, wild — name the danger, then solve it together
Vocab in a sentence: hear the word, then an example sentence
review_from_prior_lessons: hill, cave, berry, together, careful, Don't worry, team
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：遇到熊時他們做對了什麼？（quiet / don't run / hide）
請孩子用單字說例句：It's a big brown bear.
問：他們在哪裡避雨？（Pip's cave）

vocab.alt: Daddy praises George for being brave

pages.alt: George plays with Pip and Ember outside the cave

lines.text: The next day, George went back to the cave to play with Pip and Ember.
Hello! Shall we look for berries near the cave?
Yes! There are sweet berries just down the little path.

pages.alt: The friends pick berries on a short path near the cave

lines.text: They walked a short way down the path and began to pick red berries.
These berries are yummy! I like helping.
But the sky grew grey, and a cold wind brushed their faces.
Hmm. The wind feels strange. We should not go far.

pages.alt: Thunder rolls as storm clouds gather

lines.text: Far away, thunder rumbled like a giant drum.
Is a storm coming, Pip?
Yes. Let's take a few berries and go back to the cave soon.
I'm little. I can't fly in strong wind!

pages.alt: A big brown bear appears on the berry path

lines.text: Suddenly, George stopped. A huge brown bear was on the path ahead.
The bear sniffed the berries and made a low, rumbling growl.
George… is that bear dangerous?
Yes. Stay quiet. Don't run. That is very important.

pages.alt: The three friends hide behind a rock

lines.text: They hid behind a big rock and stayed very still.
Good. Stay calm. The bear is busy with the berries.
The bear ate a few berries, then walked slowly into the trees.
My heart is beating fast, but we stayed quiet.

pages.alt: Rain begins as they hurry carefully back toward the cave

lines.text: Then cold rain began to fall, and the path grew dark and wet.
Now! Walk carefully. The cave is close. It is our shelter!
Come on, Ember. Stay close to me.
They hurried carefully back up the short path to the cave door.

pages.alt: Safe inside the cave while the storm rains outside

lines.text: Inside the cave, they shook off the rain and listened to the storm.
I was scared, but we are safe now.
Yes. Our cave is a good shelter when thunder is loud.
We did it together. We stayed calm!

pages.alt: Daddy finds George at the cave after the storm

lines.text: When the rain stopped, Daddy climbed the hill with an umbrella.
George! I was looking for you. Are you all right?
Yes, Daddy. We hid from a big bear, then waited in the cave.
Well done. You were very brave today.

quiz.q: Why do the friends want to go back to the cave?
options: Because they want to go shopping

quiz.q: What animal do they see on the path?
What should they do when they see the bear?
